title: FinanceBench: A New Benchmark for Financial Question Answering

task.value: A benchmark for evaluating LLMs on open book financial question answering about publicly traded companies.
task.quote: FinanceBench is a first-of-its-kind test suite for evaluating the performance of LLMs on open book financial question answering (QA).

architecture.value: Configurations: closed book, oracle (evidence pages given), single vector store per document, shared vector store over all documents (Langchain, Chroma, OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002), and long context with filing in prompt; context-first vs context-last prompt orders.
architecture.quote: Our vector store is implemented in Langchain44 4 https://www.langchain.com/, using a Chroma database55 5 https://www.trychroma.com/ and OpenAI embeddings (text-embedding-ada-002).

data.value: 10,231 question/answer/evidence triplets covering 40 US publicly traded companies and 361 public filings (10Ks, 10Qs, 8Ks, earnings reports) released 2015-2023; 150-case human eval sample.
data.quote: It covers 40 companies that are publicly traded in the USA and 361 public filings, released between 2015 and 2023, including 10Ks, 10Qs, 8Ks, and Earnings Reports.

window.value: Evaluation on a 150-case sample (50 domain-relevant, 50 novel-generated, 50 metrics-generated); all configurations tested in November 2023. No train split.
window.quote: We test 16 model configurations, including the Oracle and Closed book settings. All were tested in November 2023.

models.value: GPT-4, GPT-4-Turbo (128k context), Claude2 (100k context), Llama2 (llama-2-70b-chat via Replicate); temperature 0.01, max tokens 2,048.
models.quote: We test four LLMs, from three model providers: OpenAI’s GPT-4 OpenAI (2023) and GPT-4-Turbo with a 128k context window22 2 https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-4-and-gpt-4-turbo; Anthropic’s Claude2 with a 100k context windowBai et al. (2022); and Meta’s Llama2 Touvron et al. (2023).

baselines.value: Configurations compared against each other; closed book and oracle serve as reference points, single vector store as a naive retrieval baseline. GPT-3.5 tested early and dropped.
baselines.quote: The Oracle setting and the Closed Book setting are highlighted in red as these represent unrealistic evaluation scenarios that only serve as reference points.

headline_result.value: GPT-4-Turbo with shared vector store incorrectly answered or refused 81% of questions; best realistic config GPT-4-Turbo long context correct on 118 (79%) of 150; Oracle 85%.
headline_result.quote: Notably, GPT-4-Turbo used with a retrieval system incorrectly answered or refused to answer 81% of questions.

limitations.value: Single-turn questions only; only public filings and listed companies (bias to larger firms); no cross-company comparisons; some questions simplistic and some gold answers ambiguous.
limitations.quote: Equally, another limitation of FinanceBench is that it only contains publically listed companies, which necessarily biases the dataset towards larger companies and properly-audited and well-written documents.

release.value: The 150 evaluation cases are released open-source on GitHub.
release.quote: The 150 evaluation cases are available open-source.11 1 https://github.com/patronus-ai/financebench
